targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT sum((payload->'llm_tokens'->>'total_tokens')::int) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT avg((payload->'llm_tokens'->>'total_tokens')::int)::int AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='failed') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric(10,2) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT payload->'llm_tokens'->>'model' AS "Модель", count(*) AS "Вызовов", sum((payload->'llm_tokens'->>'total_tokens')::int) AS "Σ токенов", avg((payload->'llm_tokens'->>'total_tokens')::int)::int AS "Avg токенов", avg((payload->'llm_tokens'->>'inference_time_ms')::int)::int AS "Avg ms", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'llm_tokens'->>'inference_time_ms')::int)::int AS "p95 ms" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT data AS "Шаг", count(*) AS "Вызовов", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='failed') AS "Fail", avg((payload->'llm_tokens'->>'total_tokens')::int)::int AS "Avg токенов", avg((payload->'llm_tokens'->>'inference_time_ms')::int)::int AS "Avg ms", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'llm_tokens'->>'inference_time_ms')::int)::int AS "p95 ms" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT $__timeGroup(received_at, '1h') AS time, data AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'llm_tokens'->>'inference_time_ms')::int) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND status='success' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
